WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

Ship state of the art models to production.

Design and implement novel research ideas.

Build elegant training/deployment pipelines.

Join us at a pivotal moment, shape what we build and wear multiple hats as an intern!

Our recruitment process will begin in the upcoming weeks, and we will be carefully reviewing applications and assessing potential candidates for our internships. Should we find a suitable match with your qualifications and our requirements, we will be in touch to discuss the opportunity further and to advance your application to the next stage

Please Note: To be eligible for this position you should be a student currently enrolled in a post-secondary program, available for a full-time4 month internship.

As a Machine Learning Intern, you will:

- Design, train and improve upon cutting-edge models.

- Help us develop new techniques to train and serve models safer, better, and faster.

- Train extremely large-scale models on massive datasets.

- Explore continual and active learning strategies for streaming data.

- Learn from experienced senior machine learning technical staff.

- Work closely with product teams to develop solutions.

You may be a good fit if you have:

- Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as Tensorflow, TF-Serving, JAX, and XLA/MLIR.

- Experience using large-scale distributed training strategies.

- Familiarity with autoregressive sequence models, such as Transformers.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

- A demonstrated passion for applied NLP models and products.

- Bonus: experience writing kernels for GPUs using CUDA.

- Bonus: experience training on TPUs.

- Bonus: papers at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

- Analyze data and running experiments to drive impact

- Ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly

- Create metrics, reports, and dashboards to inform and run the business

- Extend Stripe’s metrics semantic layer

- Build new data assets and improve existing data assets to support decision-making, products, and business processes

- Assess the impact of decisions, product launches, and product improvements using business analytics and A/B testing

- Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly

- Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns

Who you are

- Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

- Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

- Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

- Enrolled in a quantitative Bachelor’s or Master's degree program (e.g. Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028

- Experience with SQL

- Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

- Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing and debugging data pipelines

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects

- Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Cost Optimization to help shape how we manage, forecast, and optimize infrastructure investments across our engineering organization. This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, product, and finance. You'll work to understand where infrastructure costs originate, how they scale with product usage, and how engineering decisions influence broader business outcomes. You'll build the systems, tooling, and data models needed to make infrastructure spending more transparent, predictable, and actionable. Beyond identifying opportunities for cost optimization, you'll help establish the forecasting models, unit economics, and infrastructure cost insights that inform capacity planning, product pricing, and long-term business decisions. We're looking for someone with a strong infrastructure engineering background who has experience thinking beyond the technology itself. You understand how infrastructure supports products, how costs scale, and how to translate technical insights into meaningful business decisions. What You’ll Do Build and evolve internal tooling, dashboards, and reporting systems to improve visibility into infrastructure and engineering-related costs. Analyze and optimize cloud infrastructure and engineering-owned vendor spending, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability. Develop cost attribution and unit-cost models that connect infrastructure consumption to services, products, and business usage. Partner with product and engineering teams to understand how infrastructure architecture, usage patterns, and technical decisions impact costs and product economics. Collaborate with finance to develop infrastructure cost forecasts, financial models, and reliable data inputs that support budgeting and long-term planning. Provide infrastructure cost insights that help inform product pricing decisions and broader business strategy. Establish meaningful infrastructure cost KPIs, reporting processes, and governance practices to improve financial accountability. Support infrastructure vendor management, including cost analysis, utilization, contract renewals, and optimization opportunities. Drive cost-conscious engineering practices across teams while balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and business needs. What We’re Looking For Strong background in infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering, with experience owning or influencing infrastructure strategy and technical decisions. Deep understanding of AWS or comparable cloud environments, including infrastructure architecture, resource utilization, and cost drivers. Experience analyzing infrastructure costs, identifying optimization opportunities, and understanding the financial implications of technical decisions. Understanding of how infrastructure consumption translates into unit costs, product economics, and broader business outcomes. Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, finance, or business stakeholders. Exposure to infrastructure budgeting, forecasting, cost modeling, or capacity planning. Strong analytical skills and experience building tools, dashboards, or data models to support technical and business decisions. Ability to take ownership of complex initiatives, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively across technical and nontechnical audiences. Nice to Have Experience working at a growing technology company where you've owned responsibilities spanning infrastructure, product, and business operations. Experience developing infrastructure unit economics or contributing to product pricing decisions. Familiarity with FinOps principles, cloud cost management, or infrastructure financial planning. Experience with showback, chargeback, or cost attribution frameworks. Experience with CloudZero, Apptio, CloudHealth, or similar cost management platforms. Experience managing engineering vendors, infrastructure partnerships, or procurement processes. Previous experience building a new engineering capability, internal platform, or operational process from the ground up. About the Role

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers travel for some of the world's largest brands through our APIs, white label products and fintech, and every dataset we hold tells a story our partners need told clearly, repeatedly and fast. As a Senior Data Scientist on HTS you will own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of partners and build the machinery that answers their questions about supply health, pricing competitiveness and performance once, then answers them every week. You will be judged less on the sophistication of your models than on whether the people you work with, inside Hopper and across partner commercial teams, make better decisions because of you.

What would your day-to-day look like

- Own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of HTS partners, working alongside Partner Success and Commercial to understand what they need, deliver it, and present it directly to their teams

- Design and templatize repeatable reporting on supply health, pricing competitiveness and tenant performance that scales across hotels, flights, homes and cars without being rebuilt each time

- Use AI assistants, agents and code generation tools as everyday collaborators to automate the repetitive parts of analysis and reporting, and help the broader team adopt the same practices

- Frame and run exploratory analyses that deepen our understanding of partner and traveler behavior, and translate what you find into clear recommendations for product, engineering and business leaders

- Apply machine learning and statistical methods to large, messy datasets where they move the needle, and recognize when a simple, well explained metric is the better answer

- Build dashboards and self serve reporting in BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Sheets, with an eye toward making yourself unnecessary for routine questions

- Partner closely with product and engineering so the data we collect supports the questions our partners will ask next

An ideal candidate has

- A degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience

- Extremely strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a track record of answering hard questions with data across more than one domain or product line

- A proven ability to turn complex technical work into simple, credible narratives for non technical and executive audiences, including external partners

- Comfort being partner facing, presenting findings, fielding tough questions live and building trust with commercial counterparts

- Deep SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses such as BigQuery, plus fluency in Python and Pandas or R for large scale data preparation and analysis

- Hands on, daily use of LLM based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot for writing code, SQL, analysis and documentation, and a point of view on where they help and where they fall short

- Experience building or deploying automated and agentic workflows, from scheduled pipelines to LLM driven report generation and prompt or skill libraries, that turn one off analyses into repeatable products

- Experience with data mining, machine learning and statistical modeling, and the judgment to know when to reach for them

- Experience with business reporting and experimentation tools such as Tableau, Looker or Amplitude

- A strong bias toward simplifying, templatizing and shipping over polishing

- Travel industry experience in lodging, air, vacation rentals or car rental, or in a marketplace, B2B platform or API distribution business, is a plus

- Experience with geographic data in search, filtering or recommendation, or working with external customers in a consulting, solutions or customer analytics capacity, is a plus

Perks and benefits of working with us

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

- Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan

- Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

- HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

- All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue's telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

- All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

- Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

- Unlimited PTO

- Carrot Cash travel stipend

- Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

- Open communication with management and company leadership

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

- Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.

- Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.

- Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.

- HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.

- Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company's fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

title: Senior Product Analyst
description: Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments. Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch. By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com . Senior Product Analyst About the Role We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to turn product data into the decisions that grow Later's revenue and retention across Later Influence, Later Social, and Later Creator. As we invest in a unified data foundation and instrument more of the customer and creator experience, this role makes sure product and technology leaders have access to the data and reports to know what is working, what is not, and what to build next. Reporting to the operations leader in Product & Technology, you'll partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Data, and the business teams that sell and deliver our products. You'll own the analytical foundation for the Product & Technology department, with regular exposure to senior leadership. Measurement and instrumentation will span across all three of our products and our platform portfolios with customers/users including Creators, Small/Medium Businesses, Enterprises and internal professional services teams. This role will play a critical part in establishing the foundation for measurement and analytics within the Product & Technology department and setting us up for scale. As the company continues to grow in size and revenue, Product Analytics will provide the intelligence and confidence to inform decision-making across the department. What You’ll Do Foundations and Strategy Own the product analytics strategy and roadmap, deciding what we measure, in what order, and how we leverage our measurement tools. Own and evolve the Product & Technology metrics framework across outcomes, usage, adoption, satisfaction, delivery, operational effectiveness, quality, and AI adoption, with one set of definitions that Product, Engineering, and business teams share. Define the leading indicators that connect product activity to business outcomes such as revenue, retention, multi-product attach, creator earnings, and net revenue retention. Prioritize measurement gaps by business impact and make the tradeoffs and investment case explicit to leadership. Partner with Product and Technology Leadership and across stakeholders in Services, Business Operations, Sales, Marketing, Research and Partnerships to align product analytics strategy and implementation with our department objectives and targets. Instrumentation and Data Quality Establish event tracking standards, naming conventions, and a tracking plan so new features ship measurable from day one. Instrument usage and adoption at the portfolio, product, and feature level so leaders see how customers and creators actually use what we ship. Partner with Engineering and Data to bring delivery and quality signals, such as cycle time, deployment frequency, and defect trends, into the same views as product data, applying DORA principles where they fit. Partner with Engineering and Data to specify the data models and pipelines that make product data reliable, accessible, and consistent across products. Own data quality for product metrics, building audits and monitoring that catch tracking gaps and drift before they distort a decision. Tooling, Process, and Scale Evaluate, select, and implement the product analytics and tooling stack - in collaboration with the Data & Analytics function - including clear build versus buy recommendations. Build the metrics scorecard, core dashboards, and playbooks that give every metric a clear definition, owner, source, and target, and coach Product Managers to frame questions, set success metrics, and interpret results so they answer routine questions themselves. Establish the operating rhythms for measurement: experiment design and review, success metrics defined before build, post-launch readouts, an intake process for analytics requests, and a quarterly metrics review against targets. Shape the roadmap, role profile, and hiring bar for the analysts who join after you, and help us hire them. Insight Define the framework for how we measure within the department, for example the adoption and impact of AI features and internal AI tools, and what good looks like as usage matures. Deliver high-impact analyses of funnels, cohorts, retention, satisfaction, and experiments that drive product decisions and prove the value of the foundation while you build it. Bring leaders a clear recommendation, not a dashboard, on where to invest, what to stop, and what to test next. What Success Looks Like Product and Technology leaders make roadmap and investment calls from shared, trusted numbers, spend their time debating what to do rather than what a metric means, and every team can see how what it ships performs for customers and creators. Measurement coming from Product & Technology is widely understood and read with a high degree of confidence. Within your first 60 days, you've audited our current instrumentation and data quality, shared a prioritized gap list with leadership, and shipped a first decision-ready analysis that a product leader used to change a roadmap or prioritization call. By 90 days, the core metrics across the framework have agreed definitions, owners, and sources, a documented tracking plan is in place, and a first version of the metrics scorecard is live and trusted by Product, Engineering, and business leaders. Within 6-12 months, the product tooling decisions are made and implemented, core usage, adoption, delivery, and quality metrics are reported on a regular cadence, every launch has success metrics defined before build and a readout after, Product Managers self-serve routine questions, and your work has driven a measurable improvement in a metric you and your manager agree on (for example activation, retention, or multi-product attach). What You Bring 6+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with scope that extends beyond a single feature or team, at a scaled technology company. A track record of building or substantially establishing product analytics foundations (tracking plans, metric frameworks, dashboards, tooling) at a SaaS, marketplace, or platform company. Advanced SQL skillset and familiarity with Python/R for analysis, and hands-on experience implementing and administering a product analytics tool (such as Amplitude) and BI tools, including supporting build versus buy decisions. Experience specifying event instrumentation and data models with Engineering and Data teams, and working with cloud data warehouse and ETL tools (such as BigQuery and dbt). Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests and other experiments, with sound statistical judgment about causality and confidence. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation that senior leaders act on. A track record of getting up to speed quickly in a new domain and delivering results. Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building structure where it doesn't yet exist. Experience with a multi-product, marketplace, or creator economy business is a plus. Our approach to compensation: We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors. Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only. The salary range listed for this role reflects the zones that applies to the location of this posting. To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted. Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package. Salary range: For candidates located in the US: $125,000-205,000 USD For candidates located in the Canada: $110,000-160,000 CAD Where we work: We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility: At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit . We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer . All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process. Product Boston Vancouver

About the role

This role turns people data into the decisions that shape how Wealthsimple hires, grows, and keeps its people. You will build the models, the analysis, and the data products that show how talent moves through Wealthsimple, where it concentrates, who is at risk of leaving, and what the workforce looks like a year out. Reporting to the Director, People Analytics, you will own that work end to end, from the question through to the thing people actually use. Success looks like recurring people decisions getting made from what you built.

About the team

People Analytics sits within People and Communications. We are growing the people domain and want to get deeper into our data, through the models, data products, and analysis that leaders across the company use to make calls about talent. We are a small team, building like a startup inside the People team. Analytics developers own the data foundation, analysts handle day-to-day reporting, and software engineers build the products that put insights in front of managers. As our first data scientist, you will help set what best in class looks like for people analytics at Wealthsimple.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the model building and the deeper analysis on people data, including attrition risk, workforce forecasting, and how talent moves and develops across the company.

- Build people data products that leaders keep coming back to, working with our software engineers to put them in front of managers across Wealthsimple.

- Move up and down the data stack as the question demands, from raw data through to the model and the surface it lands on.

- Turn open questions from leaders and partners across the company into analysis they can act on, and be clear about what the data can and cannot support.

- Bring statistical rigour to how we understand talent density and performance management, forming hypotheses and testing them so people decisions are data informed.

- Set the analytical standard for the function and raise the level of craft around you, through how we test, document, and review our work.

SKILLS YOU BRING

- 5+ years in data science or a related quantitative role, owning ambiguous problems end to end.

- Advanced SQL and Python, applied to work you have taken all the way to production rather than left in a notebook.

- Applied statistics and causal inference. You can pick a method, defend it, and explain why a correlation is not enough for the decision in front of you.

- Experience building and evaluating predictive models on messy operational data, including the judgment to say when a model is not the right answer.

- Experience turning analysis into recommendations that senior leaders act on, including pushing back when the question itself is wrong. You lead with the outcome, then explain how you got there.

- Comfort working close to the data layer, with modelled datasets, point-in-time history, and a cloud data platform such as Snowflake.

NICE TO HAVE

- HR data literacy: employee lifecycle events, job hierarchies, headcount types, and compensation structures.

- Workforce planning or headcount forecasting.

- Experience with survey and engagement data.

- Experience measuring people performance, such as review ratings, calibration outcomes, or goal attainment.

People analytics experience helps, but it is not required. If you have done this kind of work in product, marketing, growth, or customer analytics and you are curious about people data, we want to hear from you.

WHO YOU ARE

- You are energised by building, and you do not need a paved road to do good work.

- You think about privacy the way a good engineer thinks about security, as a design constraint rather than an obstacle.

- You would rather ship a useful answer and improve it than hold a perfect one back.

- You are direct about uncertainty and say what you do not know before anyone asks.

- You move between technical and non-technical conversations naturally.

- You are pragmatic about AI tools and know where they speed you up and where they do not.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE

- Ground-floor impact: Most of this work hasn’t been done yet, so you’ll shape how it gets done.

- Visibility: Your work goes in front of leadership and shapes real decisions about talent.

- Builders around you: Your models ship into products managers use, not slide decks

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles.

That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. Post-secondary Diploma/Degree with specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Lead Software Developer your key area of responsibility will be designing, building and maintaining efficient, reusable, reliable code to develop high throughput, performance critical, scalable applications. You will be responsible for leading the development of scalable code, prototypes, and PoCs, taking ownership of complex, long-term projects, and ensuring timely delivery. You will need to work closely with other software developers, engineers, internal technical teams, cross-functional partners, product managers, and external stakeholders.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player and mentor with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working under pressure in a flat organization, and possessing excellent verbal and written communication skills to document complex technical systems. -

-

-
Mentor other developers on the team and work with the team leads to set the direction of the team and guide key stakeholders on execution choices and trade-offs, and advise manager with insights and recommendations to improve the team.

-
Appropriately document system design and architecture such that it is easy to understand, maintain and extend.

-
Support Geotab global strategic initiatives.

-
Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule (if applicable).

-
Independently evaluate technical solutions, while contributing to the team roadmap.

-
Present and lead technical discussions and training at the department wide level.

-
Stay up to date on emerging technologies and changes in best practices in the development field and present them to senior leadership for consideration.

-
Write complex scalable, high quality and secure software in a variety of programming languages and environments, such as C#, JavaScript, SQL.

-
Serve as a domain expert (ex GBQ), consulting in the area of expertise for the department and across the organization.

-
10 - 12 years of experience as a Software Developer using object-oriented programming to build scalable applications.

-
Post-secondary Diploma/Degree with specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Enterprise
description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be a key analytical partner to our Customer Success organization and our product-led, digital customer journey. You’ll shape how the business understands what drives adoption, retention, and expansion, analyzing how customers move from sign-up to activation, engagement, conversion, expansion, and renewal, and turning that into clear, actionable insight on the growth levers leadership can act on. Sitting within our centralized analytics function, you’ll work closely with Customer Success, Product, Growth, RevOps, and Data Engineering, bringing strategic thinking, deep PLG expertise, and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations that move the business forward. You’ll help define how digital and scaled success programs are measured, size opportunities, show where to invest next, and help shape the data foundations that underpin our AI and automation capabilities. How we’re using AI today On the Analytics team, we're thoughtfully embedding AI into how we work with data. That looks like using AI to accelerate SQL development, pressure-test interpretations, turn complex datasets into clear executive narratives, and increasingly, building Generative BI applications that let stakeholders explore and interrogate data on their own. We approach AI the same way we approach data quality: with clear standards, human accountability at every consequential decision, and a commitment to getting it right before it influences the business. Beyond our own workflows, our role is evolving to ensure 1Password has the data foundations, governance, and structure its broader AI transformation depends on. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US. What we're looking for: - 5+ years in analytics within complex B2B SaaS environments, ideally in a product-led or self-serve motion. B2C or hybrid B2B/B2C experience is a plus - Strong PLG and customer lifecycle expertise, including activation, PQLs, cohort analysis, retention, churn, expansion, and growth modeling - Experience partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Growth stakeholders and translating open-ended business questions into analytical frameworks - Ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear recommendations and communicate them to senior leaders, influencing decisions and priorities - Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), statistical modeling, or predictive techniques (e.g., churn or propensity modeling) in a business context - Advanced SQL and strong experience with large-scale analytical datasets, including product usage and event data - Hands-on experience with modern AI/BI tools (Hex, Omni, Claude, Dust, or similar) - Comfort in modern cloud data ecosystems: Snowflake, Databricks, dbt - Experience working with GTM and customer platforms such as Salesforce and a CS platform (Gainsight, or similar). Familiarity with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Segment, or similar) is a plus What you can expect: - The opportunity to do meaningful analytics work across adoption, retention, expansion, and digital success in a fast-moving, product-led SaaS environment - Close partnership with Customer Success stakeholders and a direct line to leadership on the growth levers that matter most, contributing to how the organization measures performance and makes day-to-day decisions - Involvement in building the data foundations and analytical standards that Customer Success and 1Password’s broader AI capabilities will depend on - Exposure to how AI gets applied in customer analytics, including Generative BI and AI-assisted workflows across forecasting, anomaly detection, and insight generation - Cross-functional collaboration across Customer Success, Product, Growth, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data teams - An environment where there’s a lot to build and your contributions will have real impact, ideal for someone who is eager to grow, take ownership, and make their mark USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $122,000 USD and $171,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $105,000 CAD and $147,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others. Our approach to remote work We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing 👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs 🩺 Competitive health benefits 🏝 Generous PTO policy Growth and future 📈 RSU program for most employees 💸 Retirement matching program 🔑 Free 1Password account Community 🤝 Paid volunteer days 🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly 🌎 Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. description_formatted:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role:

Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. The Data Platform group supports everyone at Faire who depends on data: Product Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Strategy, Finance, and Product. Our job is to make sure the data is there, it's right, and people can find it and query it without having to think about the plumbing underneath.

We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own that plumbing. Concretely, this means the path data takes out of our production databases (CockroachDB and MySQL) and into a place where analysts and data scientists can query it. Today that involves Fivetran, Kafka, Spark, and Airflow landing data in Snowflake and Databricks. It works, but it grew up over time and it shows. We want someone who can design the next version of it, build the hard parts personally, and bring the rest of the company along.

This is a hands-on role. You'll also be the person other teams come to when they need to know how data should move at Faire.

What you'll do:

-
Set the technical direction for how data moves from production systems into our analytical stores, and own the roadmap to get there over the next couple of years.

-
Build the CDC and streaming ingestion layer: CockroachDB changefeeds and MySQL binlogs into Kafka, then into Iceberg tables on S3. You'll be responsible for the hard details like ordering, deduplication, late data, schema changes, and backfills.

-
Implement data contracts and quality checks throughout our platform

-
Put real ownership and SLAs on the datasets the business runs on, and wire quality checks into the platform with tools like Anomalo and Monte Carlo so we hear about broken data before a dashboard or a model does.

-
Run Airflow and Fivetran well, and have an opinion about what we should keep buying versus what we should build.

-
Own reliability for the platform: SLOs, on-call, incident reviews, and the follow-through so the same thing doesn't break twice.

-
Work with the senior engineers, data scientists, and analysts who depend on this platform, and lead the migration of existing pipelines onto the new one without breaking what they rely on.

-
Mentor the engineers around you. We want the team's data engineering practice to be better because you were here.

Qualifications:

You've built and run data infrastructure that other teams depended on, at meaningful scale, and you've been the person setting direction for it, not just working on it.

-
Deep experience with change data capture and streaming ingestion from operational databases through Kafka. You know what goes wrong with ordering, duplicates, snapshots, and schema evolution because you've dealt with it.

-
Hands-on experience with lakehouse architectures on an open table format. Iceberg on S3 is what we use, so that's especially valuable. You should be comfortable talking about partitioning, compaction, catalogs, and copy-on-write versus merge-on-read.

-
Strong Spark skills, and experience running Databricks and Snowflake against shared storage.

-
Experience with data quality and observability in practice, including data contracts, SLAs, and tools like Anomalo or Monte Carlo.

-
Experience operating Airflow at scale and working with managed ingestion like Fivetran.

-
Strong SQL, and good instincts for how to model data so analysts and data scientists can actually use it.

-
Solid Python plus at least one of Kotlin, Java, Scala, or Go. Experience shipping infrastructure on AWS with Terraform.

-
A working understanding of data governance: access control, PII, retention and deletion, lineage, and audit.

-
A track record of leading cross-team data initiatives and migrations, and of mentoring senior engineers.

-
You can explain a technical tradeoff to a leadership team and to a new grad, and you can get people who disagree with each other to a decision.

-
You take ownership of things that are broken or unowned, and you're willing to be on call for the systems you build.

-
Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or other transaction-heavy business is a plus.

Technologies we use and teach:

-
Python, Kotlin, SQL

-
Kafka, Fivetran, Airflow

-
S3, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark

-
AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes

-
CockroachDB, MySQL, Scylla and DynamoDB

Salary range:

Canada: the pay range for this role is $216,000 to $297,000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

- Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days

- Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks

- Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location

- Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance

- Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health

- Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs

- Employer-sponsored retirement plan, dependent on country of employment

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire-form)

Privacy

For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

description: À propos du poste Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) propulse le voyage pour certaines des plus grandes marques du monde grâce à nos API, nos produits en marque blanche et notre offre fintech, et chaque jeu de données que nous détenons raconte une histoire que nos partenaires ont besoin de voir racontée clairement, régulièrement et rapidement. À titre de scientifique de données principal(e) au sein d’HTS, vous serez responsable de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires et vous bâtirez les mécanismes qui répondent une première fois à leurs questions sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance, puis y répondent chaque semaine. Vous serez évalué(e) moins sur la sophistication de vos modèles que sur la capacité des personnes avec qui vous travaillez, chez Hopper comme dans les équipes commerciales de nos partenaires, à prendre de meilleures décisions grâce à vous. À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien - Assumer la responsabilité de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires HTS, en travaillant aux côtés des équipes Partner Success et Commercial pour comprendre leurs besoins, y répondre et présenter les résultats directement à leurs équipes - Concevoir et standardiser des rapports récurrents sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance des locataires, qui s’adaptent aux hôtels, aux vols, aux locations de maisons et aux voitures sans devoir être reconstruits chaque fois - Utiliser les assistants et agents d’intelligence artificielle ainsi que les outils de génération de code comme collaborateurs du quotidien afin d’automatiser les parties répétitives de l’analyse et de la production de rapports, et aider l’ensemble de l’équipe à adopter les mêmes pratiques - Cadrer et mener des analyses exploratoires qui approfondissent notre compréhension du comportement des partenaires et des voyageurs, et traduire vos constats en recommandations claires pour les responsables produit, ingénierie et affaires - Appliquer l’apprentissage automatique et les méthodes statistiques à de vastes ensembles de données désordonnés lorsqu’ils font une réelle différence, et reconnaître quand une mesure simple et bien expliquée constitue la meilleure réponse - Créer des tableaux de bord et des rapports en libre-service dans BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude et Google Sheets, avec le souci de vous rendre inutile pour les questions de routine - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et ingénierie afin que les données que nous recueillons soutiennent les questions que nos partenaires poseront ensuite Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède - Un diplôme en mathématiques, statistiques, informatique, génie, économie ou dans une autre discipline quantitative, ou une expérience pratique équivalente - D’excellentes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec un historique démontré de réponses à des questions complexes à l’aide des données, dans plus d’un domaine ou d’une gamme de produits - Une capacité démontrée à transformer un travail technique complexe en récits simples et crédibles pour des auditoires non techniques et de direction, y compris des partenaires externes - De l’aisance en contact avec les partenaires, pour présenter des conclusions, répondre à des questions difficiles en direct et établir un lien de confiance avec les interlocuteurs commerciaux - De solides compétences en SQL et de l’expérience avec les entrepôts de données modernes comme BigQuery, ainsi qu’une maîtrise de Python et Pandas ou de R pour la préparation et l’analyse de données à grande échelle - Un usage quotidien et pratique des outils fondés sur les grands modèles de langage, comme Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor ou Copilot, pour écrire du code, du SQL, des analyses et de la documentation, et un point de vue sur leurs forces et leurs limites - De l’expérience dans la conception ou le déploiement de flux de travail automatisés et agentiques, des pipelines planifiés à la génération de rapports par grands modèles de langage en passant par les bibliothèques d’invites ou de compétences, qui transforment des analyses ponctuelles en produits réutilisables - De l’expérience en forage de données, en apprentissage automatique et en modélisation statistique, et le jugement nécessaire pour savoir quand y recourir - De l’expérience avec les outils de rapports d’affaires et d’expérimentation comme Tableau, Looker ou Amplitude - Un fort penchant pour la simplification, la standardisation et la livraison plutôt que le perfectionnement - De l’expérience dans l’industrie du voyage en hébergement, en transport aérien, en location de vacances ou en location de voitures, ou au sein d’une place de marché, d’une plateforme B2B ou d’une entreprise de distribution par API, est un atout - De l’expérience avec les données géographiques en recherche, en filtrage ou en recommandation, ou auprès de clients externes dans un rôle de conseil, de solutions ou d’analytique client, est un atout Avantages sociaux - Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d’un régime d’actions pré-IPO - Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d’assurance collective - description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Our Infrastructure Services organization is responsible for the underlying infrastructure that powers the 1Password application. It includes Compute Services, Network and Edge Services, and Stateful Services. As a Senior Staff Cloud Platform Engineer, you set the multi-year technical strategy for Infrastructure Services. You decide where the organization invests, define the architecture and standards that every infrastructure team and internal tenant builds on, and make sure our compute, network and edge, and stateful platforms evolve as one coherent system rather than three separate ones. You partner with engineering and product leadership, security, and finance to balance reliability, security, cost, and delivery speed, and you are the senior technical voice for infrastructure across the company. This is a hands-on role. You write design docs, prototype, review the hardest designs, and step into the most serious incidents. But your main impact comes from making many teams more effective and from the decisions that hold up for years. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. description: Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. About Okta Secures AI Team The Okta for AI Agents Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI. We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agentic Identity—including pioneer work with securing AI Agents and support for protocols like MCP. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the team

Our Data Science team partners deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. We're looking for data scientists with a passion for analyzing data, building machine learning and statistical models, and running experiments to drive impact. Our Fraud, Losses, and Financial Crime Data Science team builds the models and data products that protect Stripe and its users from fraud, account takeover, and financial crime. We own the full fraud and loss modeling stack - from account takeover detection and card fraud classification to merchant-level loss estimation, unsupervised anomaly detection, and financial crime risk modeling. We partner with Fraud Engineering, Financial Crimes Engineering, and Risk Operations to bring these systems into production and ensure they have measurable impact on Stripe's financial integrity and user trust.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

- Applying probability distributions, statistical inference, and hypothesis testing to quantify uncertainty and evaluate business outcomes

- Using Python or R for data analysis, data processing, visualizations, statistical modeling, machine learning, predictive analytics, automation, and implementing causal inference and experimental analyses

- Building, training, and evaluating predictive models across regression and classification tasks for bias-variance trade-offs and model selection

- Modeling temporal dependencies, seasonality, and trend decomposition to generate and evaluate time-series predictions

- Identifying structural patterns, clusters, and outliers in unlabeled data

- Deploying models in production and adjusting model thresholds to improve performance

- Designing, running, and analyzing complex experiments and leveraging causal inference designs

- Using SQL and Spark to create, transform, and analyze large datasets

- Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly

- Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns.

Who you are

- Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

- Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

- Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

- Enrolled in a quantitative PhD program (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028

- Experience with SQL and a scientific computing language (such as Python, R, etc.)

- Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding

- Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing and debugging data pipelines

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects

- Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

description: Join us to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians At Neo, we’re on a mission to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. Life at a rapidly scaling tech startup isn’t for everyone. It’s complex, fast-paced, high-pressure, but also incredibly fulfilling. Since its founding in 2019, Neo has gained incredible traction and is one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in Canada. - #1 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 for 2023, 2024, and 2025 https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/neo-financial-achieves-first-ever-three-peat-win-as-number-one-on-deloitte-s-technology-fast-50-list-889692540.html — the first company ever to achieve a three-peat at the top! - #1 Fastest Growing Company in Canada for 2024 by Globe & Mail https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240927952651/en/Neo-Financial-Ranks-No.-1-on-The-Globe-and-Mail%E2%80%99s-2024-List-of-Canada%E2%80%99s-Top-Growing-Companies - Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards - Team of 500+ people - 1M+ customers - 10K+ retail partners This is a remote-friendly position but candidates must be located within Canada. THE ROLE Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over years but when it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative. Neo has been Canada's fastest-growing company for three years running. The platform behind that growth is built entirely in-house: 150 services in production, hundreds of pull requests merged every week, tens of millions of transactions processed every month. Engineers own their services from architecture through production. There is no QA team to hand work off to and no DevOps team to manage your deployments. Neo if looking for a Staff engineer who remains hands-on. You write code, not just docs. You shape architecture and raise the technical ceiling across teams in a program, not only inside one squad. You are a sparring partner for Engineering Managers and Directors on hard technical calls, and you drive multi-team work that would otherwise stall or fragment. Our stack is GraphQL, Mongo, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and React Native on AWS. If you have spent time at a company where good ideas died in committee and you know you could be going faster, this is the environment those engineers tend to thrive in. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Own and ship critical services and shared libraries end to end: design, implementation, production delivery, and long-term health. - Set the architectural bar across multiple teams in your program: review designs, catch cross-team dependency risk early, and drive the target state when current systems will not scale. - Lead scoping and planning for large, complex projects that span teams; keep product and engineering goals aligned without waiting for perfect requirements. - Build and evolve tools, templates, and patterns that many teams use, so the whole program moves faster. - Raise and own the technical debt that blocks reliability, security, or scale; get the work onto the roadmap and see it through. - Keep production honest: observability, alerting, incident response, and blameless follow-through with actionable fixes. - Mentor Senior engineers and coach teams through pairing, design reviews, and deliberate knowledge sharing. - Advise Engineering Directors and Managers on tech debt, delivery risk, and when to ship an MVP versus invest in a durable system. - Treat AI as a force multiplier for yourself and the teams you support: standards, guardrails, and review expectations, not one-off prompting. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - You have roughly 10+ years building production systems, including serious time as a senior or lead IC, with impact that holds up at scale. - You have been the technical owner of systems that mattered: you shaped the architecture, not only implemented against someone else's plan. - You still write high-quality code and take pride in being a major contributor and code owner, not only a reviewer of others' work. - You think in systems: coupling, contracts, failure modes, cost, and second-order effects across services and teams. - You are opinionated about architecture, can defend a position, and change it when the argument is better. - You level up the people around you.
